THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, John Anthony Emmanuel Amarathunga, Minister of Lands, herebydeclare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land AcquisitionAct, that the land described below is needed for a public purpose andwill be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

An allotment of land in total extent of about 0.0024 Hectare,depicted as Lot ‘‘A’’ in Advance Tracing No. Ya/JEF/2016/213 anddated 05th August, 2016, prepared by the Surveyor-General , situatedin the Village called Chundikuli, Ward No. 06 within the MuncipalCouncil limits of Jaffna in the Grama Niladhari Division No. J/66 ofEachchamoddai, in the Divisional Secretary's division of Jaffna inJaffna District in Northern Province and bounded as follows:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Name of the land not known – Extent: About0.0024 HectareNorth , East and South: Property of Jaffna Municipal Council; West:Old Park Road.
John A. E. Amarathunga,Minister of Lands.
Ref. No.: 4-3/9/2016/WS/101.Ministry of Lands,‘Mihikatha Medura’,Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla.15th March, 2017.
